nom: Clarins Total Cleansing Oil & Makeup Remover

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the oil rinses off completely without leaving skin greasy, with one noting it helped with sebum control and did not add oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin say it removes makeup while leaving skin soft and rehydrated rather than stripped or tight.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and a calm, comfortable result, though one sensitive reviewer reacted to an ingredient and discontinued use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with acne-prone combination skin that usually reddens easily reports no irritation from this cleanser.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin describes it simply as a reliable everyday cleansing oil.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her fifties with dry, dehydrated, sensitive/mature skin reports her face feels clean, soft and comfortable after use.

concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers say the product rehydrates or does not dehydrate skin, leaving it soft and comfortable after cleansing; no reviewer reports increased dryness from the oil itself.
concerns.redness: One reviewer whose skin normally turns red and angry reports this cleanser did not trigger that reaction.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states it protects the skin barrier while still cleansing effectively; no negative barrier reports appear.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts and one says it keeps skin clearer and helps with blackheads; no reviewer reports breakouts from the product.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer notes it does not clog pores and even improves the look of blackheads with regular massage; no dissenting reports of clogged pores appear.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports it helps with sebum control and does not leave oily skin greasier after use; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Effective on waterproof and heavy makeup

extraits.titre: Great features, but unfortunately not for me.
extraits.texte: Texture and smell is so nice, removes makeup very easily. I always follow up any oil cleansers with face wash, to make sure I wash it off. It was only one new item in my routine that broke me. Unfortunately I am sensitive to some ingredients.

Okay this is like $40, BUT it lasted me months. Maybe 4? You could get 5 if you do one pump i think. I wear alot of makeup and i always go in with a remover then my makeup eraser to get residue off. This gets eye makeup off with ease and i never was rubbing my eyes with the eraser like some other products. I dont feel the greasy feeling after and i have acne skin, this didn't seem to clog pores. I only needed 1 pump but did two to reeealy spread it around. It's some money but for how long it lasted i am going to repurchase and feel confident that i dont need to work hard to get my makeup off at the end of the day. :)!

I'm not going to lie, I have been gatekeeping this one for a while… but after about 5 bottles of this stuff, I must share that it is the best oil cleanser on the market. It is perfectly gentle, does not trigger acne/pimples at all- if anything, it keeps my skin more clear. Massaging your face with this daily will also help wit appearance of blackheads. It feels luxurious, scent is mild/barely there, and my skin is bright and hydrated after use. It gets makeup off like a charm and is the only facial cleanser I use. I need a bottle for my shower and my bathroom counter. It's pricey but lives up to its price tag when comparing it to cheaper oil cleansers.
Removes all makeup and sunscreen easily! Skin feels soft and clean afterwards and my sensitive skin isnt irritated at all.

I've been using Clarins Cleansing Milk for years but after watching a YouTube video from Clarins UK, I decided to try the cleansing oil. It's is Amazing! I'm 57 with dry, dehydrated, sensitive skin. My skin feels clean but soft and comfortable after I've washed my face. The smell is spa like and I look forward to washing my face each night. It also removes my eye makeup. I follow up with the hydrating toner ( yellow), double serum and super restorative.

I recently purchased this because I wanted to give an oil cleanser a try instead of my usual beloved sensibio micellar water and I'm glad I did! This will be something I buy again and again! I'm usually very nervous to switch up my routine because I have acne prone combo skin that is sensitive and gets red and angry over anything but this has not irritated my skin. I actually never write reviews but I'm such a fan I had to.

This cleansing oil is fabulous, it's like a little massage for your face, completely dissolves any makeup including stubborn mascara and leaves skin smooth and plump. I buy on repeat, and was delighted to see Clarins offer a large refill, great to have on hand and to reuse the original bottle. This oil does not clog pores or make skin oily or greasy.
